name: Photo tools
description: Look after photos without exiftool: it reads EXIF with PHP and edits with ImageMagick. Info shows size, camera, date taken and GPS (one photo, or a table of a whole folder); Check warns about GPS locations hidden in files you may share, huge files, CMYK JPEGs, rotation tags that other tools ignore, tiny images and mixed formats; Strip metadata removes everything (GPS, camera, dates) after applying the rotation; Web-ready copy applies the rotation, removes metadata, converts to sRGB and shrinks to a size you choose (max=1600 quality=82); Enhance auto-levels and sharpens gently; Batch makes web-ready copies of a whole folder in one zip; Contact sheet shows a folder at a glance; Duplicates finds exact copies and near-duplicates (the same picture resized or re-saved); Rename plan proposes names by date taken (nothing is renamed). The type of a file is taken from its content and passed to ImageMagick as an explicit decoder, so a file named .jpg that is really an SVG or a script is refused. The originals are never changed. With exiftool installed it also shows every tag, writes artist, copyright, title, keywords and rating into a copy, and shifts all dates.

presets.label: Info: size, camera, date, GPS (a photo or a folder)
presets.description: One photo: pixels, megabytes, camera, date taken, orientation tag, GPS position. A folder: a table of every photo with the same columns and how many carry a GPS location.

presets.label: Check (GPS, size, colours, rotation)
presets.description: For a photo or a folder: a hidden GPS location (warning: privacy), files over 8 MB, CMYK JPEGs, rotation tags other tools ignore, images under 640 px, no date taken, mixed formats, and files that are not photos at all (judged by content).

presets.label: Strip all metadata (GPS, camera, dates)
presets.description: A copy of the photo with ALL metadata removed, the rotation applied first so it still looks right. Choose .jpg, .png or .webp as the output.

presets.label: Web-ready copy (rotate, strip, sRGB, shrink)
presets.description: Applies the rotation, removes the metadata, converts to sRGB and shrinks the long side to at most 1600 pixels (never enlarges), JPEG quality 82. Change them in the extra arguments: max=1200 quality=75.

presets.label: Enhance (auto-levels, light sharpening)
presets.description: A conservative auto-fix: applies the rotation, stretches the levels and sharpens a little. Keeps the metadata.

presets.label: Batch: a whole folder web-ready (zip)
presets.description: Every photo of the folder as a web-ready JPEG (rotation applied, metadata removed, sRGB, long side at most 1600 px) in one zip. Extra arguments: max=1200 quality=75.

presets.label: Contact sheet (a folder at a glance)
presets.description: One picture with a thumbnail and the name of each photo (the first 60).

presets.label: Duplicates: exact and near
presets.description: Exact copies (same bytes) and near-duplicates (the same picture resized, re-saved or lightly edited, found by a picture fingerprint), largest first. Nothing is deleted or moved: look before removing.

presets.label: Rename plan by date taken
presets.description: A list of current name to proposed name (2026-01-05_14-30-02.jpg) from the date taken. Nothing is renamed: apply it by hand or ask the agent.

presets.label: All metadata tags (exiftool)
presets.description: EVERY tag in the file (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, maker notes: lens, ISO, serial numbers, software, owner), privacy-sensitive ones first: location, who, which camera. Needs exiftool.

presets.label: Set tags in a copy (artist, copyright, title ...)
presets.description: A COPY of the photo with tags written: artist="A. Name" copyright="© 2026 A. Name" title=... description=... keywords=a,b rating=0-5 datetimeoriginal="2026:01:05 14:30:02" in the extra arguments. Choose an output with the same extension as the photo. The original is untouched.

presets.label: Shift every date (a camera clock that was wrong)
presets.description: A COPY with every date and time moved: type +2h, -30m, +1d or +1d2h30m in the extra arguments. The original is untouched.
